تتنازعوا (form VI)
# تَتَنَازَعُوا (tatanāzaʕū) /ta.ta.naː.za.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَنَازَعَ (tanāzaʕa)
# تُتَنَازَعُوا (tutanāzaʕū) /tu.ta.naː.za.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَنَازَعَ (tanāzaʕa)
